d:
Build strength that works through rotation, balance, and complex movement so your whole body feels more capable in every direction. This strong full body practice challenges your core, stability, coordination, and control while asking you to stay grounded and breathe slowly under pressure.
Rotation is one of the most natural ways the human body moves, yet it is often missing from how we train. Move with intention and finish feeling stronger, more centered, and better prepared for movement beyond the mat.
